notes.title: Low-End Optimization Update
notes.content:
Hi, an optimization update is out for the demo/prologue:
If you have a weak PC, the game should now run a lot better (better FPS), just be sure to set View Distance to Medium/Low.

Don't forget that the full game is releasing in just a few days on June 18!

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.content:
- Fixed a visual glitch where random conveyor belt items would show on creatures and other objects.
- Made the message about opening the tech tree stop appearing earlier.
- Fixed an issue where tech recipe quests would complete when you manually craft the item instead of only when you select the item in the machine recipe.

Thanks for all your feedback everybody.
You can join our [url=https://discord.gg/gwfWfUEW7q]Discord[/url] or make a Steam discussion post to leave feedback. I read all your comments.
Please leave a Steam review to help the game reach more players.
Thanks!
